span.div:
Step 1: User sends request ────▶ App Server receives
Step 2: App Server categorizes ──▶ HTTP 200, 4xx, or 5xx
Step 3: Metrics agent records ──▶ {total: +1, errors: +1 if 5xx}
Step 4: Collector batches ──▶ Aggregates into 60s buckets
Step 5: Enricher annotates ──▶ Adds {service, region, version}
Step 6: TSDB stores ──▶ Writes to Prometheus time-series
Step 7: Calculator queries ──▶ Reads window of buckets
Step 8: Budget computed ──▶ New budget_remaining value
Step 9: Policy evaluated ──▶ Check thresholds, fire alerts
Step 10: Action taken ──▶ Gate deployments, page on-call
